newsitem.title: USA: Stoico Restaurant chairman adds president title.
newsitem.headline: Stoico Restaurant chairman adds president title.

text.p: Stoico Restaurant Group Inc said Thursday its chairman, Louis Stoico Jr., has been elected to the additional post of president, effective immediately.
The company said Stoico, the founder and previous president, will fill the vacancy created by the resignation of Timothy Jeffrey late last year to pursue other interests.
Stoico Restaurant Group operates and franchises a chain of 15 Italian casual dining restaurants under the name Spaghetti Jack's. It also operates a chain of 22 sandwich shops.
